name: MAC Mobility | AC <-> PW | Sticky/Non-sticky
reference_table: Local->PW: Withdraw; suppression YES; Local loop NO. PW->Local: Advertise; suppression YES. Sticky AC->PW: IGNORE. PW->Sticky AC: prefer sticky + RT-2
infra_reason: Uses Spirent as VPLS BGP peer on SI-enabled EVPN instance (PW_TEST_ELAN). VPLS RTs are under seamless-integration > protocols > bgp (ONLY valid location). PW is 'Installed' because only Spirent peers via l2vpn-vpls for this EVI. Full chain: ISIS+LDP+BGP l2vpn-vpls. Spirent sends MPLS-labeled L2 frames via vpls-stream for PW MAC learning. See ~/.cursor/spirent-reference/vpls-pw-establishment.md.

prerequisites.expect: instance {pw_test_evpn_name} with seamless-integration and export-l2vpn-vpls route-target
prerequisites.fix_via: Create EVPN instance PW_TEST_ELAN WITH seamless-integration. VPLS RTs MUST be under SI > protocols > bgp subtree.
prerequisites.critical_note: VPLS RTs (export-l2vpn-vpls) are ONLY valid under seamless-integration > protocols > bgp. NOT at instance-level BGP. NEVER remove SI from this instance -- it deletes all VPLS RT config. Discovered 2026-04-11.
prerequisites.validation_note: VALIDATED PE-1 2026-04-11: PW Installed after SI + VPLS RT under SI subtree

prerequisites.fix_via: spirent_vpls_provisioner.py provisions ISIS on DUT (P2P, area 49.0001) and Spirent (area converted to STC hex 490001)
prerequisites.stc_encoding_trap: STC Area1 requires concatenated hex '490001' not dotted '49.0001'. SystemId uses dotted format '0000.0000.0003'. These formats are NOT interchangeable.
prerequisites.validation_note: VALIDATED PE-1 2026-04-11: ISIS L2 Up in 43s after _area_to_stc_hex() fix

prerequisites.note: Route to Spirent loopback 6.6.6.6/32 must be installed via ISIS for LDP to create a label binding
LDP session provides MPLS label for FEC 6.6.6.6/32 (the VPLS nexthop)

prerequisites.validation_note: VALIDATED PE-1 2026-04-11: BGP ESTABLISHED in 53s from protocol-start

prerequisites.pass_criteria: PW exists for {pw_test_evpn_name} with Status = Installed (NOT Uninstalled/BNI)
prerequisites.validation_note: VALIDATED PE-1 2026-04-11: PW Installed after SI + correct VPLS RT under SI + BlkSize=8
fail_checklist: 1. RT mismatch: Spirent --vpls-rt must exactly match DUT SI import-l2vpn-vpls RT
2. Missing SI: export-l2vpn-vpls only valid under seamless-integration subtree
3. ISIS area hex: STC needs '490001' not '49.0001'
4. BlkSize too small: must cover remote site-id (BlkSize=1 silently fails)
5. No route to loopback: ISIS not converged
6. No LDP label: LDP not OPERATIONAL
7. BGP not ESTABLISHED: check neighbor IP alignment
8. PW Uninstalled: competing EVPN RT-2 routes force BNI

prerequisites.pass_criteria: Ingress-label field present and non-zero for {pw_test_evpn_name}

prerequisites.pass_criteria: At least one AC interface on the non-SI instance for local MAC learning

spirent_vpls_setup.description: Spirent acts as a remote VPLS peer. PW is established via BGP l2vpn-vpls. Spirent sends MPLS-labeled frames with vpls-stream using PE-1's PW ingress label. PE-1 pops the MPLS label and learns inner source MAC as a PW-learned MAC.

mac_trigger_functions.ac_to_pw_move: Learn MAC on AC via protocol-start, then send same MAC via vpls-stream on PW
mac_trigger_functions.pw_to_ac_move: Send MAC via vpls-stream on PW, then learn same MAC on AC via protocol-start

scenarios.name: Non-sticky: Local AC -> PW; withdraw RT-2; suppression counted
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Learn MAC on AC via spirent_create_mac_block + protocol_start. 2) Stop protocol, remove device. 3) Send same MAC via spirent_create_vpls_stream(mpls_label=pw_ingress_label). DUT detects MAC moved from local AC to PW.

show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

scenarios.name: PW -> Local AC (non-sticky); advertise RT-2
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Send MAC via vpls-stream (PW path). 2) Stop, remove stream. 3) Learn same MAC on AC via spirent_create_mac_block + protocol_start. DUT detects MAC moved from PW to local AC.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

scenarios.name: Sticky AC -> PW: IGNORE move (SW-194578)
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Configure sticky-interface on AC. 2) Learn MAC on sticky AC via protocol_start. 3) Send same MAC via vpls-stream on PW. 4) Verify: MAC stays on sticky AC, move ignored.

scenarios.name: PW -> Sticky AC: prefer sticky AC; advertise RT-2
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Send MAC via vpls-stream on PW. 2) Configure sticky-interface on AC. 3) Learn same MAC on sticky AC via protocol_start. 4) Verify: sticky AC wins, RT-2 re-advertised.
